content: कादम्बरम् .²1 A spirituous liquor distilled from the flowers of the Kadamba tree; निषेध्य मधु माधवाः सरसमत्र कादम्बरम् <ls>Śi. 4. 66</ls>. .{@-री@} .²1 A spirituous liquor distilled from the flowers of the कदम्ब tree. .²2 Spirituous liquor or wine in general; कादम्बरीसाक्षिकं प्रथमसौहृदमिष्यते <ls>Ś. 6</ls>; or कादम्बरीमदविघूर्णितलोचनस्य युक्तं हि लाङ्गलभृतः पतनं पृथिव्याम् <ls>Udb.</ls>; ˚रसभरेण <ls>K. 240</ls>. .²3 The fluid issuing from the temples of a rutting elephant. .²4 An epithet of Sarasvatī, the goddess of learning. .²5 A female cuckoo. .²6 The rain-water collected into clefts or hollow places. .²7 A female bird (सारिका). .²8 <ab>N.</ab> of a celebrated story by Bāṇa; the heroine is of the same name, being a daughter of Chitraratha Gandharva.
